name: m5-lazydepth-paired-t8

variantDescriptions.eager: lubDepth computed before solving and merging, as in base
variantDescriptions.lazy: lubDepth computed only when solve lubs/glbs two or more bounds, or mergePrefixAndArgs merges prefixes or arguments that differ

description: As m4-lazydepth-paired-full at 8 concurrent full compiles of the scala corpus (JMH `-t 8`, single shot), 24 GB G1, patched JDK 26, laptop. 3 forks of 6 + 10 iterations, eager and lazy alternating by iteration.
